$doc: Campaign controller — the single spec sheet ops edits to retune the program. The engine and frontend both read this file. Env vars still hold the SECURITY gates (MEGAPOT_ACTIVE, MEGAPOT_WHITELIST, keys) — this file holds the PRODUCT parameters.

campaign.name: MegaHence Rewards - Season 1
campaign.$tierSinceMs: multiplier tiers count Hence AI basket volume from the ORIGINAL season start (2026-08-24 11:59 UTC) so pre-launch baskets keep their tier; startMs still governs which fills earn credit. Hub mirrors it.
campaign.$note: Season 1 window per the official rules doc: Aug 24 2026 11:59 UTC through Sep 9 2026 00:00 UTC (15 days). start/end are hard bounds - fills outside the window never credit. Deploy dispatch start_ms must match (env overrides this sheet).

eligibility.$products: product suites this campaign covers: perps (native HL coins) | xyz-equities (coins prefixed xyz:) | spot (Robinhood Chain swaps via the hence backend's relay-spot feed — SPOT_FILLS_URL; fills carry Hence's 25bps app fee as builderFee and credit that EXACT fee, not a bps-of-notional recompute, because our own receipts ledger records it per fill) | baskets (fills recorded via thesis executions — needs app stitch) | predictions (not yet supported)
eligibility.$symbols: empty = ALL symbols on the enabled products qualify (Season 1 rule: every product on Hence). Add tickers to restrict.
eligibility.$excludeZeroFeePairs: symbols currently running zero-fee promos (no fee revenue → no credit), e.g. the xyz rebate campaign list

economics.$note: 4.0bps = Hence's LIVE builder-fee take (verified /api/config hlBuilderFee=40 tenths). Charged on routed orders regardless of maker/taker, so accrual is identical on maker flow. Ticket conversion always uses Megapot's live ticketPrice().
economics.$spotNote: Relay-spot fills credit their EXACT recorded fee (builderFee on the feed row = the 25bps app fee our own ledger stored for that swap) times rolloverShare — no spotFeeBps knob exists on purpose: a bps recompute could drift from what was actually charged, and unlike HL (where the engine reads the venue's feed) the spot fee is first-party ground truth.

multipliers.requires: Base rate - every qualifying trade counts.
$1,000+ of thesis basket volume this season.
$2,500+ of thesis basket volume this season.
$5,000+ of thesis basket volume this season.
$10,000+ of thesis basket volume this season.

caps.$globalBudgetUsdc: SEASON 1 BUDGET (Sarthak, 2026-09-02): 820+ tickets seeded into the pool wallet = 200 activation packs (FCFS) + 420 streak boxes (30/day x 14) + 200 multiplier rebate cap; trading-fee rebate is UNCAPPED and topped up daily. This ceiling is a spend safety stop, not the budget: keep it above wallet balance and raise it with each top-up (deploy dispatch budget_usdc overrides). Retro: Megapot sends 12 tickets/day to the pool wallet (168 over the season) - see $retroTickets.
caps.$retroTickets: Megapot's 12 tickets/day land in the pool wallet as NFTs. They are inventory, not USDC: to hand them to users the engine would transfer TicketNFTs instead of buying - NOT built yet. Until then they sit in stock (cover for rolled-over queues) and the ledger keeps buying with USDC.

firstTradeBonus.$note: activation pack: account + email + first qualifying trade >= minTradeUsd ($100) opens a pack of 1-5 tickets DRAWN AT RANDOM from a fixed season pool - 150 pack slots totalling exactly 200 tickets, drawn without replacement (odds at launch: 76.0% / 17.3% / 4.7% / 1.3% / 0.7%). The draw depletes s.packSlots in the ledger, so odds drift as slots fill and the pool can never overshoot. dailyMintCap still paces minting per UTC day. QUALIFICATION: one fill >= minTradeUsd ($100) OR combined in-window volume >= minTradeUsd ($100).

terms.title: MegaHence Rewards - Season 1 rules
steps: Season 1 runs from August 24, 2026 (11:59 UTC) to September 9, 2026 (00:00 UTC).
Create your Hence account and link a verified email.
Place your first qualifying trade of $250 or more - or reach $250 of combined volume - to open your activation pack: 1-5 free tickets, drawn at random from the 200-ticket season pool.
Keep trading: 0.04% (4.0bps) of your qualifying volume - every product on Hence, maker or taker - becomes reward credit. There is no limit on tickets earned this way.
Streak bonus: trade on 3 days in a week with $1,000 cumulative volume for +1 ticket; 5 days and $5,000 for +1 more.
Run thesis baskets to climb multiplier tiers - up to 5x, cutting the volume needed per ticket in half.
Tickets mint straight to YOUR wallet. Megapot draws daily - match numbers to win tiered prizes.

actions.action: Sign up + verified email + first trade >= $100
actions.reward: 1-5 ticket pack, drawn at random (200-ticket season pool)

actions.action: Qualifying volume (maker or taker, any product)
Daily streak box - every day you trade
actions.reward: a surprise box: day 2 pays out 60% of the time (+1 ticket); later boxes hit less often but hold 2-8 tickets
the big boxes: 4, 5, 6 and 8-ticket drops on days 11-14
tiers 2x-5x: mint on 90% down to 50% of the volume

terms.caps: Per wallet, up to 5 tickets mint per day and 15 per rolling week; anything earned beyond the caps queues automatically and mints at the daily pace - nothing earned is lost. Activation packs mint at most 30 tickets per UTC day across all users and streak boxes at most 30 per UTC day (both reset at 00:00 UTC; later grants mint the next day automatically). Season pools: 200 activation-pack tickets, 420 streak-box tickets, 200 multiplier tickets; the trading-fee rebate itself is uncapped.
disclosures: Tickets are entries in Megapot’s daily draw. Winning is chance-based; no prize is guaranteed. Prizes, odds, draw mechanics and claims are operated by Megapot under Megapot’s terms.
Tickets mint non-custodially to your own wallet on Base. Hence never holds your tickets or winnings.
Reward credit has no cash value and converts only to tickets at Megapot’s live ticket price (about $1) at mint time.

Activation pack sizes are drawn at random from a fixed season pool of 200 tickets across 150 packs: 1 ticket (76.0%), 2 (17.3%), 3 (4.7%), 4 (1.3%), 5 (0.7%). Odds shift slightly as the pool depletes; every qualifying activation receives at least 1 ticket while the pool lasts.
Zero-fee promotional pairs are excluded from earning while their promotion is active.
A working email is required for the activation pack; draw results and win alerts are sent there. Email quality checks may be added during the season.
Marketing consent is captured when you link your email and recorded either way - you can decline and still participate fully.
Multiplier tiers (2x-5x) activate as basket tracking goes live this season; until then the base rate applies.
Availability subject to eligibility and jurisdiction. Parameters may be retuned between seasons.

assetTable.note: Volume shown mints ONE ticket at the base 1x tier (0.04% of volume at the $1 live ticket price). Maker or taker - same accrual. Every product on Hence qualifies; higher tiers cut the volume needed by their factor.

streak.$note: trade-day streak within the week: at day N with >= min cumulative qualifying volume, +1 ticket, once per checkpoint per week per wallet; shared 20-ticket season pool, first come first served. NOTE: the rules-doc draft mentioned a 15-ticket pool in one place and 20 in another - 20 is live pending veto.

opsGrants.$note: one-time ops credit grant, applied once per id per wallet and recorded in the ledger - used here for the supervised first mainnet mint test

2026-09-02 22:45Z: supervised proof-of-fix mint after PR #14 (standing allowance + explicit approve gas + simulate before buy) - one ticket; the buy cycle must log 'standing allowance set' then 'bought'

$multipliers: DECIDED 2026-09-03: tiers are KICKERS on top of base minting - 2x = +25% credit on qualifying volume, 3x = +50%, 4x = +75%, 5x = +100% (200% of fees back). Tiers unlock on thesis-basket VOLUME (entry $1,000 per the rules doc). The $2,500/$5,000/$10,000 rungs for 3x-5x are proposed defaults pending final sign-off. Tiers activate when basket tracking goes live; base rate applies until then.

streakBox.$note: DAILY SURPRISE BOX (replaces the day-3/day-5 checkpoints while enabled): every distinct qualifying trade day since campaign start rolls one box against engine/src/streakBox.js STREAK_BOX_MATRIX - day 2 hits 60% (x1), hit-rate falls every day after, box size rises to 4-8 tickets past day 10. EV: 5-day trader ~2.2, 10-day ~4.7, 14-day ~7.8 tickets. Grants come from this shared season pool and flow through the same streakTicketsPending credit + daily caps.
streakBox.$minDayUsd: a trade day only opens a box once the day's qualifying volume reaches this - a $1 trade must not roll a 60% box
streakBox.$dailyCap: season-wide: at most this many streak-box tickets credit per UTC day (FCFS by cycle order); the rest wait on the wallet and credit the next day - nothing earned is lost

$requireBuilderFee: Only fills that carried Hence's builder fee count for credit, packs and streak boxes. Direct HL trades earn nothing (they earn Hence nothing).

multiplierBonus.$note: the EXTRA tickets multiplier tiers produce (above base fee rebate) are capped season-wide at 200. Tier enforcement in the engine is not built yet (tiers need the basket-volume feed) - this is the cap it must honour when it lands.

testReset.$note: Team-test reset (2026-09-03): node src/run.js reset <wallets> wipes those wallets' ledger state and returns their pool draws. The hub clears its per-wallet markers when resetEpoch changes.
